title: Outcome Over Learning? Evidence from Student Use of AI Code Assistants for Unit Test Writing
abstract: arXiv:2611.14664v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) code assistants are rapidly being adopted in programming education, yet little is known about how students naturally use these tools when given unrestricted access. In a user study investigating AI-assisted unit test writing, we observed that a majority of students adopted a one-shot interaction strategy, asking the AI to generate a complete unit test directly from the initial requirements. While this approach is capable of efficiently producing a solution, it shifts students' focus from learning how to write effective unit tests to simply completing the task. Moreover, because students rarely engaged in critically evaluating, refining, or iterating on AI-generated output, they may be missing opportunities to develop the critical thinking skills that are essential for effective and responsible use of AI. translated_title: 结果重于学习？来自学生使用AI代码助手编写单元测试的证据
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）代码助手正在编程教育中迅速普及，然而对于学生在无限制访问权限下如何自然地使用这些工具，人们知之甚少。在一项关于AI辅助单元测试编写的用户研究中，我们观察到大多数学生采用了一次性交互策略，要求AI直接根据初始需求生成完整的单元测试。虽然这种方法能够高效地产出解决方案，但它将学生的注意力从学习如何编写有效的单元测试转移到了仅仅完成任务上。此外，由于学生很少对AI生成的输出进行批判性评估、改进或迭代，他们可能错失了培养批判性思维技能的机会，而这些技能对于有效且负责任地使用AI至关重要。为了将学生的关注点从结果转向学习，我们还讨论了如何通过训练、问责等方式来促进这一转变。
tldr: 本研究通过用户研究发现，大多数学生使用AI代码助手编写单元测试时采用一次性生成策略，缺乏批判性评估与迭代，导致学习机会的缺失，并探讨了如何引导学生将关注点从完成任务结果转向真正的学习。
en_tdlr: This user study finds that most students adopt a one-shot interaction strategy when using AI code assistants for unit test writing, shifting their focus from learning to task completion and missing critical thinking opportunities, and discusses how to redirect student focus from outcome to learning.
